text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...It's over. The Kikuka Sho, that is.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... may have lost, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll win.

Yearning to win, giving it her absolute all in the
Kikuka Sho. After the race that day,
something felt just a little bit different than usual.
And once we return to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo! Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You guys...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, we couldn't really talk much
after the Live. So I came with Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hayahide. Today, you...
felt way scarier than last time.
Seriously... super scary.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I'm gonna grow even more too!
Uwooooohhhhhh~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, she's way too selfish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly though, I feel the same way.
It's like she showed us Hayahide's true hidden power.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Hayahide.
Do you have a goal race in mind for your next one?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Next... huh. That's true.
We ran through the Classic Triple Crown route.
In that case, beyond this winter—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm. A prestigious spring race.
I certainly want to set our sights on that stage of the strong held in Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's a crucial race if you want to become the strongest of your generation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Got it.
I'll participate in that too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"So that means I want to win with it too.
See ya."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ......I feel like Taishin has her own selfish side as well, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Still... "wanting to win," huh? Heh, perhaps I've finally reached the same level as you all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-kun.
Next time, we're going for the win too!

Her smile was far brighter
and clearer than it had ever been before.
